title: Del Mar | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set along a pristine stretch of Gulf-front shoreline in Seacrest Beach, this extraordinary four-level estate captures the essence of elevated coastal living. Sweeping views of emerald waters unfold from nearly every room, while timeless coastal architecture and refined interiors create a welcoming yet sophisticated atmosphere. Expansive living spaces are designed for gathering, featuring a stunning chef’s kitchen with premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and an elegant dining area ideal for memorable meals and celebrations. Large windows and balconies invite in the Gulf breeze, filling the home with natural light and a constant connection to the breathtaking seaside surroundings. Outdoor living takes center stage with a spectacular Gulf-facing pool deck designed for relaxation and entertaining. An infinity-edge pool, swim-up bar, and sunken dining area create a resort-style setting overlooking the sand and sea, while a private boardwalk offers direct access to the beach just steps away. Multiple living areas and spacious guest suites provide comfort and privacy across the upper levels, many opening to private balconies with panoramic sunset views. Perfectly positioned near the charming communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this remarkable beachfront retreat blends privacy, space, and unforgettable Gulf views into an exceptional coastal escape.
